tools.name: centrixone_list_contacts
tools.description: List CentrixOne contacts with their list memberships (the ContactScript table). Use basic_filter for a contact, an external id or a list; add one filter_field condition to narrow further. Endpoint: GET Contacts-<account>-<apiKey>-<basic>.awp.

tools.name: centrixone_list_contact_lists
tools.description: List the contact lists of the account (CentrixOne calls them scripts). Use the list ids in centrixone_list_contacts and centrixone_upsert_contact. Endpoint: GET Scripts-<account>-<apiKey>.awp.

tools.name: centrixone_list_users
tools.description: List the CentrixOne users (sales representatives) of the account. Use them to find who owns a contact or an opportunity. Endpoint: GET Users-<account>-<apiKey>-all.awp.

tools.name: centrixone_list_opportunities
tools.description: List sales opportunities with their stage and value. basic_filter selects the list (for example "S999") or "all" (default). Endpoint: GET Opportunities-<account>-<apiKey>-<basic>.awp.

tools.name: centrixone_list_revenue_types
tools.description: List the revenue types of the account at one level: 1 = RevenueTypes, 2 = RevenueTypesSub1, 3 = RevenueTypesSub2. Endpoint: GET RevenueTypes[Sub1|Sub2]-<account>-<apiKey>-all.awp.

tools.name: centrixone_upsert_contact
tools.description: Create a contact, or edit one, in CentrixOne. Pass contact_id to edit a known contact, or external_id to match your own id; with neither, a new contact is created. Fields you omit keep their value; an empty string clears a field. list_id adds the contact to a list. Endpoint: POST Contacts-<account>-

findings.title: Description references secrets/credentials
findings.detail: Description of "centrixone_list_contacts" references sensitive artifacts (apikey). A tool description has no reason to mention credentials.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: centrixone_upsert_contact · Private data: centrixone_list_contacts, centrixone_list_contact_lists, centrixone_list_users, centrixone_list_opportunities, centrixone_list_revenue_types, centrixone_upsert_contact · Public sink: centrixone_upsert_contact.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: centrixone_upsert_contact · Private data: centrixone_list_contacts, centrixone_list_contact_lists, centrixone_list_users, centrixone_list_opportunities, centrixone_list_revenue_types, centrixone_upsert_contact · Public sink: centrixone_upsert_contact

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
